t: This is Baker Street, in Marylebone, in the City of Westminster. Some historians say it was named after the son of the builder William Baker, who finished building the street. It began as a high class residential street, but today it is mainly commercial premises. Two people died on this street. Susanna Whatman was a writer on household management, who came to notice about two hundred years after her birth. Doctor Philomena Uyanwah was a Nigerian doctor who served as Chief Medical Officer in Biafra during the civil war, and advised the World Health Organization.
